OVERVIEW

CONTEMPRO Branding & Identity project was undertaken to shape the brand’s visual language and ensure a streamlined, modern aesthetic across all applications. It crafted a refined logo system and established a cohesive colour palette, typographic hierarchy and graphic treatment to reflect the brand’s progressive yet elegant character. The identity extends across digital and print collateral, ranging from business stationery and signage to packaging and social-media visuals, equipping the brand to present a unified, polished presence in every context.
